coverage_manifest: heartbeat.ts — VERDICT: mostly clean. Cache-gated (30s) synchronous DB write via registerSession -> runPgQuery -> spawnSync('uv','run','python') against Postgres (3s timeout), runs CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS every fire. Cost bounded to ~1/30s. Fail-open. No injection. Skips ~/.claude. OK.

maestro-state-manager.ts — VERDICT: bug found. Pure regex + locked state-file IO, no subprocess (cheap). BUG: line 348 writeState(state) called WITHOUT sessionId in the 'looksLikeAnswers' branch -> writes to default/non-session state file (finding D2c-05).

guardrail-enforcer.ts — VERDICT: contract concern. Pure regex + temp-file IO (cheap, fail-open). Outputs non-standard {result:'block',reason}; file header claims 'HARD BLOCKS' but line 173 admits UPS hooks cannot block (finding D2c-06).

skill-activation-prompt.ts — VERDICT: clean for THIS repo. runPatternInference spawns 'uv run python' on every prompt ONLY if scripts/agentica_patterns/pattern_inference.py exists; it does NOT exist in continuous-claude (verified) so it's a cheap existsSync no-op here. Reads skill-rules.json + temp files each prompt. Uses {result,message} output shape (see D2c-06). Heavy but bounded.

bus-session-populator.ts — VERDICT: contributory. mutateBus file-lock write only (200ms cap, no subprocess, fail-open). shouldSeed() shares memory-awareness skip set but has NO synthetic-prompt filter -> stamps <task-notification> blobs as bus current_intent (part of finding D2c-01).

memory-awareness.ts — VERDICT: hot-path heavyweight + 2 bugs. Daemon probe (1500ms) + up to 2 'uv run python' subprocesses (local 2s + DB 5-12s) + 2s Braintrust HTTP emit + intel-bus append per qualifying prompt (recall latency already SEED-08). emitBraintrustScore is correctly awaited (emit invariant intact). BUG1 D2c-01 (synthetic-prompt/XML intent pollution root cause). BUG2 D2c-02 (expandGitQuery over-broad substring match).
maestro-detector.ts — VERDICT: clean. Pure regex + statSync re-entrancy guard, fail-open, no subprocess. Uses {result,message} shape (D2c-06).

user-confirmation-detector.ts — VERDICT: injection + junk-creation. Cheap regex on most prompts, but on resolution/memory matches runs execSync with shell:true (60s timeout) interpolating the user prompt into a store_learning.py command, escaping only double-quotes (finding D2c-04, seed_ref SEED-01).
ralph-watchdog.ts — VERDICT: clean. readRalphUnifiedState (file read), explicit early-exit when no active Ralph, fail-open. Cheap.
ralph-progress-inject.ts — VERDICT: clean + nit. Early-exits when Ralph inactive; file IO only; self-times to <100ms. Dead import spawnSync (D2c-07).
ralph-retry-reminder.ts — VERDICT: clean + nit. Early-exits when Ralph inactive or queue empty; file read only. Dead imports spawnSync/existsSync/join (D2c-07).

sentry-error-context.ts — VERDICT: dead. Reads input.user_message (wrong field; Claude Code sends 'prompt') AND not registered in active settings.json (12th UPS slot is braintrust_hooks.py). Double-dead (finding D2c-03).
shared/intent-extractor.ts — VERDICT: gap. META_PATTERNS strip NL meta-phrases only; no XML/synthetic-marker stripping (contributes to D2c-01).
shared/output.ts — VERDICT: reviewed. outputContinue/outputWithMessage emit {result:'continue'[,message]} — the non-standard shape behind D2c-06.
shared/db-utils-pg.ts registerSession/runPgQuery — VERDICT: reviewed. Synchronous spawnSync uv-Postgres, 3s timeout; consumed by heartbeat (cache-gated).

findings.title: Intent-pollution root cause: no UserPromptSubmit hook filters Claude-Code synthetic prompts (<task-notification> etc.) before using them as recall intent / bus intent; expandGitQuery then swallows the whole XML blob

evidence.quote:
"intent":"<task-notification>
<task-id>btm9rp4ie</task-id>
<tool-use-id>toolu_01WtsmufRAD6vMrDUydA6a6o</tool-use-id>
<output-file>... </output-file>
<status>completed</status>
<summary>Background command "Commit Phase 1 memory hardening" completed (exit code 0)</summary>
</task-notification> git remote workflow"

findings.telemetry: SUMMARY.md: intent-pollution 24.6%, memory-recall hit-rate 27.4%. memory-recall.jsonl rows where intent begins with '<task-notification>' or '<system-reminder>' are the population.
findings.observe_how: grep -c '"intent":"<' .claude/logs/memory-recall.jsonl ; every match is a synthetic-prompt fire that ran a recall + logged + (via bus-session-populator) stamped the bus intent.
causal_links: drives SUMMARY intent-pollution 24.6% and low hit-rate 27.4%

findings.title: expandGitQuery substring-matches git keywords inside any prompt ('pr' in 'approve'/'preview', 'commit' inside arbitrary text), short-circuits extractIntent, and appends 'git remote workflow' — corrupts the recall query for non-git prompts

evidence.quote: const intent = gitExpanded || extractIntent(input.prompt);

findings.telemetry: Any recall-log intent ending in ' git remote workflow' whose prompt is not actually about git ('pr' matches approve/preview/spring; 'commit' matches commitment).
findings.observe_how: grep "git remote workflow" .claude/logs/memory-recall.jsonl and inspect whether the source prompt was git-related; false positives confirm the substring bug.
causal_links: amplified by D2c-01 (XML blob containing the word 'Commit' triggered the append)

findings.title: sentry-error-context reads input.user_message (wrong field — Claude Code sends 'prompt') so it can NEVER inject; also not registered in active settings.json — double-dead hook

evidence.quote:
const message = input.user_message;
    if (!shouldSuggestSentry(message)) return null;

findings.telemetry: Active settings.json UserPromptSubmit array has 12 entries; the 12th is braintrust_hooks.py user_prompt_submit, NOT sentry-error-context (verified by enumerating commands).
findings.observe_how: node -e on .claude/settings.json hooks.UserPromptSubmit: sentry-error-context.mjs is absent. Even if added, input.user_message is undefined so shouldSuggestSentry returns false on every prompt.
causal_links: instance of SUMMARY '35/111 hook srcs never registered'

findings.title: user-confirmation-detector builds store_learning.py command by string-interpolating the user prompt into execSync({shell:true}), escaping only double-quotes — shell-metachar injection / corruption + frequent low-value junk rows on common confirmations

evidence.quote:

  /(?:this|it)(?:'s| is)(?: now)? (?:fixed|working|resolved|done)/i,
...

findings.telemetry: archival_memory rows with tags 'user_confirmed,verified' whose content contains shell metachars (backtick, $(), ;) or truncated/garbled text; SEED-01 junk-creator family.
findings.observe_how: A confirmation prompt containing backticks or $(...) (e.g. "it's working — `date`") flows unescaped into a shell:true execSync; only double-quotes are escaped. Inspect store_learning rows for metachar artifacts.
causal_links: same junk-creation/store-corruption family as SEED-01 (interactive path, not the scheduled one)

findings.title: maestro-state-manager 'answers received' transition calls writeState(state) without sessionId — the interviewComplete flag is written to the default (non-session) state file, so the session-scoped read on the next prompt never sees it
findings.telemetry: Maestro stuck at interview phase after the user answers AskUserQuestion: next prompt's readState(sessionId) returns interviewComplete=false because the flag landed in the default-session file.
findings.observe_how: Compare the two writeState call sites: every other call passes sessionId; line 348 omits it, so getStateFile(undefined) resolves to a different path than getStateFile(sessionId).

findings.title: Two divergent output contracts across the 12 UserPromptSubmit hooks: half emit ad-hoc {result:'continue',message}/{result:'block',reason}, half emit the documented hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext — the repo's own docs call additionalContext 'the reliable inject pattern', so the {result,message} hooks' context (maestro suggestion, skill activation, ralph progress, guardrail 'block') may never reach Claude
findings.telemetry: If {result,message} is ignored by the current Claude Code version, maestro-detector suggestions, skill-activation banners, ralph progress bars, and guardrail 'blocks' silently never appear in model context despite the hooks running.
findings.observe_how: Emit a known sentinel string from a {result,message} hook and grep the session transcript/additionalContext for it; compare against a hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext emit. Confirms which shape Claude Code honors for UserPromptSubmit.

notes: All 12 assigned hooks read (READ-ONLY; no tests run). Hot-path cost ranking: memory-awareness is the dominant tax (daemon probe + up to 2 uv-python subprocesses + 2s Braintrust HTTP per qualifying prompt; recall latency itself is SEED-08, not re-filed). heartbeat is a 1/30s cache-gated synchronous uv-Postgres subprocess that also runs CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS every fire (minor; folded into coverage, not a separate finding). skill-activation-prompt's per-prompt 'uv run python' pattern-inference is a NO-OP in continuous-claude because scripts/agentica_patterns/pattern_inference.py does not exist (verified) — flag it only for projects that ship that script. All 12 hooks are fail-open. Emit invariant intact: memory-awareness correctly AWAITs emitBraintrustScore (line 659). SEED-13 root cause fully traced: the synthetic <task-notification> prompt is treated as a real user prompt because no UserPromptSubmit hook (memory-awareness skip guards, intent-extractor META_PATTERNS, bus-session-populator.shouldSeed) filters Claude-Code synthetic markers; expandGitQuery then substring-matches 'commit' inside the blob, short-circuits extractIntent, and uses the entire XML as the recall query + bus intent + telemetry row. A single shared isSyntheticPrompt() guard (reject prompts starting with '<task-notification>'/'<system-reminder>'/'<local-command-stdout>') applied in both memory-awareness and bus-session-populator fixes D2c-01 at the root. D2c-06 (output-contract divergence) is the one INFERRED finding worth a 5-minute sentinel-string verification — if true it silently nullifies maestro/skill/ralph/guardrail context injection.
